verdict.rationale: Sill's own docs say the Mac host can run from the command line (`swift run -c release SillHost`). A `--synthetic` flag streams a test pattern without needing Screen Recording permission, which points to a headless, permission-free mode usable in automated environments. There is no documented CI integration, no headless iPhone/iPad client, and no scripting or automation surface for sessions. missing for 10: explicit headless/CI documentation, a non-interactive automation or scripting interface, CI examples or workflow guidance, headless client operation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: `swift run -c release SillHost` runs the same host on the command line... With `--synthetic` it streams a test pattern with no Screen Recording needed.
